text: Saffire-I concurrent flame spread averaged 1.8 mm/s over a 420 s burn.
Spread rate rose by about 100% in the reduced-height duct of Saffire-IV compared with Saffire-I and -III.
Steady spread rates in Saffire were significantly lower than in BASS at the same oxygen level and flow rate.
Steady flame size was affected by oxygen concentration and flow velocity.
